name: supabase_list_projects
description: List all Supabase projects in the account.

name: supabase_get_project
description: Get details for a specific Supabase project by its reference ID.

name: supabase_pause_project
description: Pause a Supabase project to stop compute usage.

name: supabase_restore_project
description: Restore a paused Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_project_health
description: Get health status for all Supabase services in a project (database, auth, storage, realtime).

name: supabase_get_project_settings
description: Get general settings for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_project_usage
description: Get billing and usage statistics for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_project_url
description: Get the API URL and anon key for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_api_keys
description: Get all API keys (anon, service_role) for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_organizations
description: List all Supabase organizations the account belongs to.

name: supabase_get_organization
description: Get details for a specific Supabase organization.

name: supabase_list_org_members
description: List all members of a Supabase organization.

name: supabase_run_sql
description: Execute a SQL query against a Supabase database via the REST API.

name: supabase_run_query_via_mgmt
description: Execute SQL via the Supabase management API — more reliable for DDL and migrations.

name: supabase_run_migration
description: Apply a named SQL migration to a Supabase project via the management API.

name: supabase_list_migrations
description: List all applied migrations for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_tables
description: List all tables in a Supabase project schema.

name: supabase_describe_table
description: Get all columns for a specific table in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_schemas
description: List all schemas in a Supabase database.

name: supabase_list_columns
description: List all columns across all tables in a Supabase schema.

name: supabase_list_indexes
description: List all indexes in a Supabase schema.

name: supabase_list_functions
description: List all stored functions in a Supabase database schema.

name: supabase_list_triggers
description: List all database triggers in a Supabase schema.

name: supabase_list_views
description: List all views in a Supabase database schema.

name: supabase_list_enums
description: List all custom enum types in a Supabase database schema.

name: supabase_list_publications
description: List realtime publications in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_extensions
description: List available and installed PostgreSQL extensions in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_create_column
description: Add a new column to a table in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_column
description: Update an existing column in a Supabase table (type, default, nullable).

name: supabase_delete_column
description: Delete a column from a Supabase table.

name: supabase_create_table
description: Create a new table in a Supabase database schema.

name: supabase_update_table
description: Update a table's name, schema, or other settings.

name: supabase_delete_table
description: Delete a table from a Supabase database. Use cascade=true to also drop dependent objects.

name: supabase_create_index
description: Create a new index on a Supabase table to improve query performance.

name: supabase_delete_index
description: Delete an index from a Supabase database.

name: supabase_enable_extension
description: Enable a PostgreSQL extension in a Supabase project (e.g. pgvector, pg_trgm, uuid-ossp).

name: supabase_disable_extension
description: Disable a PostgreSQL extension in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_vacuum_table
description: Run VACUUM ANALYZE on a table to reclaim storage and update query planner statistics.

name: supabase_list_roles
description: List all database roles in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_create_role
description: Create a new database role in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_delete_role
description: Delete a database role from a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_policies
description: List all Row Level Security policies in a Supabase schema.

name: supabase_get_policy
description: Get details for a specific RLS policy by its ID.

name: supabase_create_policy
description: Create a new Row Level Security policy on a Supabase table.

name: supabase_update_policy
description: Update an existing RLS policy on a Supabase table.

name: supabase_delete_policy
description: Delete an RLS policy from a Supabase table.

name: supabase_list_users
description: List all auth users in a Supabase project with pagination.

name: supabase_get_user
description: Get a specific auth user by their user ID.

name: supabase_create_user
description: Create a new auth user in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_user
description: Update an auth user's email, password, metadata, or role.

name: supabase_delete_user
description: Delete an auth user from a Supabase project.

name: supabase_invite_user
description: Send an invitation email to a user to join the Supabase app.

name: supabase_send_password_reset
description: Send a password reset email to a user.

name: supabase_ban_user
description: Ban a user from signing in by setting a ban duration.

duration.description: Duration string e.g. '24h', '7d', or 'none' to unban

name: supabase_unban_user
description: Remove a ban from a Supabase auth user.

name: supabase_sign_out_user
description: Force sign out all sessions for a specific user.

name: supabase_update_user_email
description: Change a user's email address.

name: supabase_update_user_password
description: Change a user's password.

name: supabase_list_auth_providers
description: Get the current auth configuration including enabled OAuth providers and settings.

name: supabase_update_auth_config
description: Update auth configuration — enable/disable providers, set redirect URLs, configure JWT settings.

name: supabase_list_buckets
description: List all storage buckets in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_create_bucket
description: Create a new storage bucket in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_bucket
description: Update a storage bucket's public access, file size limits, or allowed MIME types.

name: supabase_delete_bucket
description: Delete an empty storage bucket.

name: supabase_empty_bucket
description: Delete all objects in a storage bucket without deleting the bucket itself.

name: supabase_list_objects
description: List objects in a Supabase storage bucket with optional prefix/search filtering.

name: supabase_get_public_url
description: Get the public URL for an object in a Supabase public storage bucket.

name: supabase_get_signed_url
description: Generate a temporary signed URL for accessing a private storage object.

name: supabase_create_signed_upload_url
description: Create a pre-signed URL for direct file upload to a Supabase storage bucket.

name: supabase_delete_objects
description: Delete one or more objects from a Supabase storage bucket.

name: supabase_move_object
description: Move or rename an object within a Supabase storage bucket.

name: supabase_copy_object
description: Copy an object to a new path within a Supabase storage bucket.

name: supabase_list_edge_functions
description: List all Edge Functions deployed to a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_edge_function
description: Get details and status for a specific Supabase Edge Function.

name: supabase_create_edge_function
description: Deploy a new Edge Function to a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_edge_function
description: Update the code or settings of an existing Supabase Edge Function.

name: supabase_delete_edge_function
description: Delete an Edge Function from a Supabase project.

name: supabase_invoke_edge_function
description: Invoke (call) a deployed Supabase Edge Function with an optional request body.

body.description: Request body to pass to the function

name: supabase_list_database_webhooks
description: List all database webhooks configured for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_create_database_webhook
description: Create a database webhook that fires on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events for a table.

name: supabase_update_database_webhook
description: Update a database webhook's URL, events, or enabled status.

name: supabase_delete_database_webhook
description: Delete a database webhook from a Supabase project.

name: supabase_select
description: SELECT rows from a Supabase table via the REST API with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination.

name: supabase_insert
description: INSERT one or more rows into a Supabase table via the REST API.

data.description: Row object or array of row objects to insert

name: supabase_update
description: UPDATE rows in a Supabase table matching a filter via the REST API.

name: supabase_upsert
description: UPSERT rows into a Supabase table — inserts if not exists, updates on conflict.

name: supabase_delete
description: DELETE rows from a Supabase table matching a filter via the REST API.

name: supabase_list_branches
description: List all database branches for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_create_branch
description: Create a new database branch for isolated development/testing.

name: supabase_delete_branch
description: Delete a Supabase database branch.

name: supabase_get_branch
description: Get details for a specific Supabase database branch.

name: supabase_list_network_bans
description: List all IPs currently banned from accessing a Supabase project.

name: supabase_remove_network_ban
description: Remove a specific IP from the network ban list for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_network_restrictions
description: Get IP allowlist restrictions for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_network_restrictions
description: Set IP allowlist restrictions for a Supabase project (CIDR blocks).

name: supabase_full_project_overview
description: SUPER TOOL: Get a complete snapshot of a Supabase project — database tables, user count, storage buckets, edge functions, RLS policies, and health in one call.

name: supabase_provision_user
description: SUPER TOOL: Create a new auth user with metadata and optional invite email — streamlined multi-tenant user onboarding.

name: supabase_rls_audit
description: SUPER TOOL: Audit all public tables for RLS status — identifies unprotected tables, tables with RLS enabled but no policies, and fully protected tables.

name: supabase_list_backups
description: List backups for a Supabase project

name: supabase_restore_backup
description: Restore a Supabase project from a backup

name: supabase_get_auth_config
description: Get the full auth configuration for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_auth_provider
description: Enable or configure a Supabase OAuth provider (google, github, apple, etc.).

name: supabase_enable_email_auth
description: Enable and configure email auth settings (signups, confirmations) for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_enable_phone_auth
description: Enable phone/SMS auth for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_configure_saml
description: Configure SAML 2.0 enterprise SSO for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_saml_providers
description: List configured SAML providers for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_list_user_factors
description: List MFA factors enrolled by a user in Supabase Auth.

name: supabase_delete_user_factor
description: Delete an MFA factor from a user in Supabase Auth.

name: supabase_list_realtime_channels
description: List active Realtime channels in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_storage_config
description: Get storage configuration for a Supabase project (file size limits, allowed types).

name: supabase_update_storage_config
description: Update storage configuration (file size limit, allowed MIME types) for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_logs
description: Read one service from the Supabase unified log stream. Default window: last minute. Explicit ranges require both endpoints and span at most 24 hours.

service.description: api, auth, storage, realtime, or postgres

search.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of the log message.

name: supabase_get_custom_domain
description: Get the custom domain configuration for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_set_custom_domain
description: Set a custom domain for a Supabase project (requires DNS verification).

name: supabase_verify_custom_domain
description: Reverify the custom domain DNS configuration for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_delete_custom_domain
description: Remove the custom domain from a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_edge_function_secrets
description: List all secrets (environment variables) available to Edge Functions in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_set_edge_function_secrets
description: Set secrets (environment variables) for Edge Functions in a Supabase project.

secrets.description: [{name, value}] array of secrets to set

name: supabase_delete_edge_function_secrets
description: Delete secrets from Edge Functions in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_postgres_config
description: Get the PostgreSQL configuration for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_postgres_config
description: Update PostgreSQL configuration parameters for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_pooler_config
description: Get the PgBouncer connection pooler configuration for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_pooler_config
description: Update PgBouncer pooler settings (pool mode, pool size) for a Supabase project.

name: supabase_get_ssl_enforcement
description: Get whether SSL is enforced for database connections in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_update_ssl_enforcement
description: Enable or disable SSL enforcement for database connections in a Supabase project.

name: supabase_security_audit
description: SUPER TOOL: Security audit for a Supabase project — auth config, SSL enforcement, network restrictions, MFA, and custom domain status.

name: supabase_project_status
description: SUPER TOOL: Full project status — name, region, edge functions, storage buckets, installed extensions, and usage in one call.

name: supabase_get_postgres_logs
description: Read PostgreSQL logs from the unified Supabase log stream; bounded to the selected time range (last minute by default).

search.description: Literal case-insensitive substring of the log message.
